statement.p: Find the vertices, foci, axes, center (if an ellipse or a hyperbola) and asymptotes (if a hyperbola) of the conic section x^2+7 y^2 = 49

The conic section is
A hyperbola
An ellipse
A Parabola

The focal axis and the conjugate axis are
x=49 and y=7 respectively.
x=0 and y=0 respectively.
y=7 and x=49 respectively.
y=0 and x=0 respectively.

The conic section's center is at
(7,49)
(1,1)
(-7,-7)
(7,7)
(0,0)

static.solution:
49 to convert it to the equation in standard form: \frac{{x}^{2}}{49}+\frac{7 {y}^{2}}{49}=1 \Rightarrow \frac{{x}^{2}}{49}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{7}=1 \Rightarrow {\left(\frac{x}{7}\right)}^{2}+{\left(\frac{y}{\sqrt{7}}\right)}^{2}=1 For this ellipse, a=7 and b=\sqrt{7} hence c=\sqrt{{7}^{2}-\left(\sqrt{7}\right)^2}=\sqrt{42}.
Since a>b we have:
\bullet The vertices are at \left(\pm 7, 0\right),\left(0, \pm \sqrt{7}\right).
\bullet The foci are {F}_{1}=\left(-\sqrt{42}, 0\right) and {F}_{2}=\left(\sqrt{42}, 0\right).
\bullet The focal axis is the x-axis and the conjugate axis is the y-axis.
\bullet The ellipse is centered at the origin.
